correction_scope: Clarify the legal pre-agreement percentage stated in the Evernorth SEC prospectus versus the derived percentage calculated using the separately stated October 22 share count.

findings.claim: Evernorth's October 30 424B3 states that the maximum 5,218,935 shares represent 19.99% of Pubco Class A shares outstanding immediately before the October 23, 2026 Purchase Agreement was signed.
findings.source_location: Note ELOC Facility, prospectus page F-85, lines 6716-6719.

findings.claim: The same prospectus separately states that 26,094,680 Class A shares were outstanding as of October 22, 2026 and uses that October 22 count for its post-issuance dilution table.
5,218,935 divided by 26,094,680 equals approximately 20.0%. This is an October 22 denominator calculation, not a restatement of the issuer's 19.99% immediately-before-signing figure on October 23.

corrected_interpretation.relationship: These are measurements using different stated dates/denominators. They are not treated as contradictory. Preserve both with their date labels.

model_rules: Use 19.99% only as the issuer-reported immediately-before-agreement percentage.
Use 20.0% only as a derived ratio against the October 22 reported share count.
Do not infer the exact October 23 share denominator from rounded percentages.
Do not treat either percentage as a measure of XRP token dilution or XRP circulating supply.
Do not promote the facility to actual capital inflow or XRP acquisition without verified drawdown and purchase evidence.

source.title: Final prospectus for up to 5,218,935 Class A shares under Cantor committed equity facility, filed 2026-10-30

next_action: Retrieve a primary-source Class A share count as of immediately before the October 23 agreement if available; otherwise retain the issuer's 19.99% and the October 22 derived 20.0% as separately dated observations.
